items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And of course Freddie Green, Count Basie, and Gus Johnson was the drummer.

ctx.x: On bass was a gentleman by the name of Gene Ramey I think, either Gene Ramey or Al Hall. My memory is hazy there. And of course Freddie Green, Count Basie, and Gus Johnson was the drummer. Now proceed.

items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I think Frank Foster was in there first, then Frank West, and he had Charlie Fowlkes.

ctx.x: Let's see, they were in the band, but
not when we first started. He picked up Frank and West later. I think Frank Foster was in there first, then Frank West, and he had Charlie Fowlkes.
Yeah. He didn't have Bobby Pater.
